title: Optimal Price Targeting
authors: Adam Nicholas Smith; Stephan Seiler; Ishant Aggarwal
eligible_reason: Compares profitability of personalized pricing policies from hierarchical Bayesian logit and ML demand models on IRI household panel; IPW profit evaluation. No DiD.
design_notes: analysis/estimation-evaluation.R: rhierMnlRwMixture and caret/glmnet/keras classifiers; policy evaluation with IPW.
data_files_note: README: user needs a license to the IRI academic data set; build-panel.R builds from raw IRI files. Only a UPC table shipped.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
